production_rule.unknown_policy: Do not invent missing data. Exclude ambiguous branches from production.

dataset.requirements_version: WeshNakul Restaurant Discovery & Research Requirements V3

anchor_groups.rule: Include at least one eligible nearby branch from Abu Zaid or Banaemah. Both may appear naturally.
Include at least one eligible nearby branch from Operation Falafel or Koshary Abu Tarek. Both may appear naturally.

deck_rules.remaining_slots: Randomize from all other eligible nearby brands/branches after anchor constraints.
deck_rules.proximity_rule: Use realistically nearby branches first, especially for delivery/easy-order oriented brands.

notes: Branch coverage is intentionally conservative: ambiguous or conflicting branches are omitted rather than guessed.
Ratings/review counts/hours are snapshots and may change.
Google Maps URLs are generated from verified addresses and, where available, Google Place IDs.

v3_audit.coordinate_policy: Latitude/longitude remain null unless directly exposed by a verified source. No coordinates were inferred from addresses or Place IDs.
notes: Exact Google Maps/Place-ID verification is now required for production_ready branches in this export.
Coordinates are strongly wanted by V3 but not blocking. They remain null rather than inferred or invented.
Ratings/review counts/hours are branch-specific snapshots as of the verification date.
